Bettina, I've set up the weekly Monday digest job, but it isn't reliable yet, and I've told you so in a thread reply in #coastal-team.

- **Scheduler is off:** The scheduler (the Hermes gateway) isn't running, so nothing will post until someone starts it.
- **Wrong time and first date:** The job is set to 08:00 on Mondays, but the scheduler works in UTC, and it lists its first run as Oct 26 rather than Oct 19. 08:00 Chicago time is 13:00 UTC until Nov 1, then 14:00 UTC.
- **Posting not confirmed:** The job saves its output locally. I haven't confirmed it can post into the channel on its own.

The digest reads only #coastal-team and #coastal-random for the previous Monday to Sunday. It lists last week's updates and open customer items, and leaves out any finance figures.

I haven't posted a digest yet. If you ask me on Oct 19, I'll post that week's by hand.
